name: @builderforce/repo-map
description: THE cloud repo map (PRD C5) in pure TypeScript: the same file reference graph, personalized PageRank and token-budgeted renderer as bf-index (builderforce-inference/crates/bf-index graph.rs + repo_map.rs), built from regex-extracted definitions (@builderforce/agent-tools/symbols), an identifier tokenizer and per-language import patterns. Runs where there is no filesystem and no bf-context binary: the durable cloud runner. Pure, I/O-free.
